title: Latency-Elastic Edge Inference: Predictive Thread-Level QoS on Raspberry Pi 5
description: Aggregated measurements (per-run and per-condition latency, queue and SLO tables), figures and LaTeX source for a comparison of three runtime controllers (Reactive, PI-SLO, MPC-Lite) for INT8 DNN inference on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76). The 2025 manuscript is not under review.
